versions.changelog:
- Initial release of tiktok-douyin-dl, a cross-platform batch downloader for TikTok and Douyin videos and photos without watermarks.
- Provides two separate commands: douyin-dl and tiktok-dl, both as precompiled single binaries for Linux.
- Supports both CLI (URL and save directory as parameters) and interactive paste-mode.
- Automatically downloads Chromium browser on first run for Playwright-based scraping.
- Features bulk no-watermark downloading, command-line updates, and built-in disclaimer.
- Includes instructions for quick updates and troubleshooting slow browser downloads.
